transformations.source:
CLASS Stack:
    CONSTRUCTOR(capacity):
        self.arr <- Array of size capacity
        self.top_index <- -1

    PROCEDURE Push(item):
        IF self.top_index == LENGTH OF self.arr - 1 THEN RETURN STRING("Overflow Error")
        self.top_index <- self.top_index + 1
        self.arr[self.top_index] <- item

    FUNCTION Pop():
        IF self.top_index == -1 THEN RETURN STRING("Underflow Error")
        item <- self.arr[self.top_index]
        self.top_index <- self.top_index - 1
        RETURN item

    FUNCTION Peek():
        IF self.top_index == -1 THEN RETURN STRING("Stack Empty")
        RETURN self.arr[self.top_index]
